title: Apply asks a word that is the same in both languages ("Menu", "Logo" in Dutch) alone once instead of splitting batches down to it, and not again in the same run; the LANG-2 rule is unchanged
steps: S1: translateLines over two batches of ten lines to Dutch, holding "Menu" twice and "Logo" once, with a model that keeps those two as written and translates the rest.
S2: translateLines with a model whose batch answers leave one line out entirely.
expect: S1: every other line Dutch; Menu and Logo kept and said as kept (3 lines); no batch smaller than ten (nothing split), at most four calls alone (Menu asked alone once only).
S2: the line left out is still split down and translated alone.
evidence: Plan #1403 item 8 (stand 16/10/2026, Dutch Joomla Apply): words Dutch as written went through the batch asked again, every split half and the tries alone, the same answer each time
fence: An unchanged answer is still no translation (LANG-2); only a readable batch's unchanged answer skips the split

tests: a word the model keeps as it is in a readable batch is asked alone, never split; the next time not at all
a line a batch could not answer at all is still split and asked alone (the LANG-2 path is kept)
g61 WordPress: a menu label a model keeps as a brand still ends translated, and the report says how
g61 Joomla: mega column titles offered as page literals end translated, "J!Pages" too
